import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
head = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
assert head == '794084bf34dabab4d8218ccb2a32e2ec81f10d51'
source_path = 'artifacts/product-reality/sprint-196/m05/golden-migration/golden-attribution.json'
execution_path = 'artifacts/product-reality/sprint-196/m05/verification.json'
sha = lambda data: hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
git_bytes = lambda revision, file: subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', revision + ':' + file], cwd=root)
def reference(file):
    data = (root / file).read_bytes()
    return {'path': file, 'sha256': sha(data), 'bytes': len(data)}

original_bytes = (root / source_path).read_bytes()
source = json.loads(original_bytes)
execution = json.loads((root / execution_path).read_bytes())
assert original_bytes == git_bytes(head, source_path)
assert source['missionId'] == execution['missionId'] == 's196-m05'
assert execution['status'] == 'passed'
assert execution['measuredWorkingTreeBase'] == source['beforeHead']
assert execution['sourceDirtyDuringExecution'] is True
assert execution['implementationHead'] == source['qualificationHead']
checks = []
for row in source['files']:
    before = sha(git_bytes(source['beforeHead'], row['file']))
    qualified = sha(git_bytes(source['qualificationHead'], row['file']))
    frozen = sha(git_bytes(head, row['file']))
    current = sha((root / row['file']).read_bytes())
    assert before == row['beforeSha256'], row['file']
    assert qualified == frozen == current == row['afterSha256'], row['file']
    checks.append({'file': row['file'], 'beforeSha256': before, 'qualificationSha256': qualified,
                   'frozenImplementationSha256': frozen, 'currentSha256': current})
for ref in source['sourceHashes']:
    assert reference(ref['path'])['sha256'] == ref['sha256'], ref['path']

output = {
    'schemaVersion': 1,
    'missionId': 's196-m07',
    'kind': 'qualified-historical-golden-carry-forward',
    'builderSelfCertified': False,
    'beforeHead': source['beforeHead'],
    'head': head,
    'afterHead': head,
    'qualificationHead': source['qualificationHead'],
    'historicalExecution': {
        'missionId': execution['missionId'],
        'head': execution['measuredWorkingTreeBase'],
        'dirty': execution['sourceDirtyDuringExecution'],
        'implementationHead': execution['implementationHead'],
        'receipt': reference(execution_path),
    },
    'historicalAttribution': reference(source_path),
    'qualification': 'The four current files and frozen implementation A bytes equal the historical m05 qualified after hashes. This carries the prior UTC migration forward; it does not relabel or rerun its measurements.',
    'files': [{**row, 'missions': ['s196-m05'], 'qualificationHead': source['qualificationHead']} for row in source['files']],
    'historicalSummary': source['summary'],
    'historicalMatrixRows': {'count': len(source['matrixRows']), 'reference': source_path + '#/matrixRows'},
}
destination = root / 'artifacts/product-reality/sprint-196/m07/golden-attribution.json'
assert not destination.exists(), 'Do not overwrite an existing attribution.'
destination.write_text(json.dumps(output, indent=2) + '\n')
program = Path(__file__).read_text()
receipt = {
    'schemaVersion': 1,
    'missionId': 's196-m07',
    'kind': 'golden-attribution-generation-verification',
    'head': head,
    'command': ['python3', str(Path(__file__)), str(root)],
    'workingDirectory': str(root),
    'program': program,
    'programSha256': sha(program.encode()),
    'source': reference(source_path),
    'historicalExecution': reference(execution_path),
    'historicalSourceHashesVerified': source['sourceHashes'],
    'checks': checks,
    'output': reference(str(destination.relative_to(root))),
    'historicalSourceBytesUnchanged': (root / source_path).read_bytes() == original_bytes,
    'newRuntimeExecution': False,
    'exitCode': 0,
}
receipt_path = root / 'artifacts/product-reality/sprint-196/m07/preparation/golden-attribution-generation.json'
assert not receipt_path.exists(), 'Do not overwrite an existing generation receipt.'
receipt_path.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'files': len(checks), 'historicalExecutionHead': source['beforeHead'],
                  'historicalExecutionDirty': True, 'qualificationHead': source['qualificationHead'],
                  'verifiedAtHead': head, 'outputSha256': receipt['output']['sha256']}))
